title: Coach Journey authors without replacing their names, weeks or participant prompts
detail: Journey Spark keeps model prose and arcs out of author fields, carries supplied source text directly for review, and retains optional explicitly stated settings/meeting extraction. Editing, guided redraw, composition, week planning and slot tools return separate questions with existing feature accounting and tiers. Server actions do not insert/update/delete content, save steering or autosave participant prompts; creation no longer launches model week population. Manual create/edit, library selection, document extraction and deterministic operational/framework templates remain. Practice typed Spark coaching seam is inherited from the separate packet. Focused inert model/server/rendered consequences and bounded source probe; no live provider or authenticated production acceptance claimed.

verify.note: Executes actual question planning/coercion with inert model and checks gated no-write action boundaries; separate server and rendered tests cover resulting behavior.
